title: Nearly 2,000 experimental variations tracked by Buer and Drew

tellings.quote: We Well, since Drew and I, we've been keeping track. We are close to 2,000

plain: A man named Charles Buer, working with a colleague named Drew at a Florida company called Exodus Propulsion Technologies, says the two of them have kept a record of their experiments and have now tested close to 2,000 variations. The work is aimed at a new kind of propulsion that the podcast calls antigravity, and he names another person, Andrew Arjima, in connection with it.
